policy: Keep every original subject. Add only the three approved main-class mappings. These are broad subject mappings, not item-level cataloguing or exact equivalences. Keep existing numeric DDC values unchanged. Do not infer mappings for other categories.

source.title: OCLC DDC Summaries: First Summary, The Ten Main Classes

mappings.label: History & geography
mappings.reason: The source history category is mapped to the broader history-and-geography main class. This does not assign a more specific historical period or region.

mappings.label: Arts & recreation
mappings.reason: The source arts-and-crafts category is mapped to the broader arts-and-recreation main class. This does not select an individual art form.

mappings.label: Religion
mappings.reason: The source religious-studies category is mapped to the religion main class for broad browsing. This does not select a religion or an individual disciplinary treatment.

unmapped_categories.reason: Insufficient subject specificity; do not equate the site's catch-all category with DDC 000.
